p: Now there cried a certain woman: 2Ki 2:3.
fear the LORD: And therefore did not fall into debt by carelessness or excess but by the hand of the Lord.
bondmen: Because I am poor and not able to pay.
pot of oil: Thus God permits his to be brought many times to extreme necessity, before he helps them, that afterward they may praise his mercy even more.
all those vessels: The Prophet declares by this to her, that God never fails to provide for his servants, their wives and children, it they trust in him.
stayed: Or ceased to increase.
rest: God here not only provided for his servant, that his debts should be paid and so kept his doctrine and profession without slander, but also for his wife and children.
little chamber: Which would be separate from the rest of the house, that he might more conveniently give himself to study and prayers.
what is to be done for: Thus the servants of God are not unthankful for the benefits they receive.
dwell among mine own people: I am content with what God has sent me, and can lack nothing that one can do for another.
no child: Which was shameful and therefore he would that his master should pray to God for her that she might be fruitful.
My head: His head was hurt badly and therefore he cried.
new moon: For at such times the people were wont to resort to the prophets for doctrine and consolation.
caught him by the feet: In token of humility and joy that she had met with him.
if thou meet any man: Make such speed that nothing may stop you in the way, Lu 10:4.

lay upon the child: Elijah did the same to the widow's son at Zarephath 1Ki 17:21 and Paul in Ac 20:10 signifying the care that should be in them, who bear the word of God and are distributors of spiritual life.
seven times: Meaning, often.
land: That is, in the land of Israel.
wild vine: Which the apothecaries call colloquintida, and is most vehement and dangerous in purging.
death in the pot: They feared that they were poisoned because of the bitterness.
shall leave thereof: It is not the quantity of bread that satisfies, but the blessing that God gives.
